title: Extend Rust report library in 3 steps: average/median, top-n/bottom-n, normalize
description: Multi-step Rust task: extend the report library with statistical functions in three steps, building on the existing sum/max_item/min_item free functions.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/lib.rs in three steps. All 4 existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — Statistical averages:
  pub fn average(items: &[Item]) -> f64
    — returns sum / count; returns 0.0 if empty
  pub fn median(items: &[Item]) -> f64
    — sort values ascending; return middle element (odd count) or mean of two middle elements (even); 0.0 if empty

Step 2 — Ranking:
  pub fn top_n<'a>(items: &'a [Item], n: usize) -> Vec<&'a Item>
    — returns up to n items sorted by value descending
    — if n >= items.len(), returns all items sorted descending
  pub fn bottom_n<'a>(items: &'a [Item], n: usize) -> Vec<&'a Item>
    — returns up to n items sorted by value ascending
  NOTE: tests calling top_n/bottom_n must bind sample() to a named variable before
  passing a reference, e.g. let items = sample(); top_n(&items, 2)
  — calling top_n(&sample(), 2) creates E0716 (temporary dropped while borrowed)

Step 3 — Normalization:
  pub fn normalize(items: &[Item]) -> Vec<f64>
    — divides each item's value by the maximum value
    — returns empty Vec if items is empty
    — if max == 0.0, returns vec of 0.0 (same length as items)

All 4 existing tests plus solution-only tests must pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: average returns sum/count and 0.0 for empty
median returns middle value for odd count and mean of two middles for even
top_n returns up to n items sorted by value descending
bottom_n returns up to n items sorted by value ascending
normalize returns each value divided by max
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `cargo test` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `cargo test` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
